name: Jenscare Scientific Co., Ltd.
summary: Jenscare Scientific Co., Ltd., a medical device company, engages in the research and development of interventional products for the treatment of structural heart diseases in the People's Republic of China. It offers LuX-Valve and LuX-Valve Plus, a transcatheter tricuspid valve replacement (TTVR) product for the treatment of severe tricuspid regurgitation and high surgical risk; Ken-Valve, a TRVR system for the treatment of severe aortic regurgitation or combined with aortic stenosis.
